name: Does The Dog Die
description: Integrates with DoesTheDogDie.com to display content warnings and trigger information for movies and TV shows in Jellyfin.

## Configuration

Three new settings are available in the plugin configuration page:

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
|  |  | Filter triggers below a minimum statistical confidence |
